units.title: 宾语从句：把一句话当成宾语
units.thinking: 英语允许把整个句子「降级」成一个名词，塞进宾语的位置。关键变化有三点：用 that/if/whether/疑问词引导，语序必须回到「主语 + 谓语」（不能像疑问句那样倒装），时态要跟主句保持呼应。中文说「我不知道他在哪」，语序照抄就行；英语却要 I don't know where he is —— 语序被重置了。

rules.formula: 主句 + that / whether(if) / 疑问词 + 陈述语序
rules.desc: I think (that) he is right. / I wonder if he will come.

rules.formula: 宾语从句一律用陈述语序
rules.desc: Do you know where he lives?（不是 where does he live）

rules.formula: 主句是过去时 → 从句时态相应后退
rules.desc: He said he was busy. / She asked what I wanted.

examples.en: I don't know where he is.
examples.zh: 我不知道他在哪。

examples.en: I don't know where is he.
examples.zh: ✗ 从句要用陈述语序

examples.en: She asked if I liked coffee.
examples.zh: 她问我是否喜欢咖啡。

examples.en: She asked if did I like coffee.
examples.zh: ✗ 从句不倒装

mistakes: 从句里保留疑问语序：where does he live ✗
whether 与 if 混用（介词后、句首、or not 前只能用 whether）
主句过去时但从句用现在时（时态不呼应）：He said he is busy ✗

questions.q: Do you know where ___?
questions.explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序。

questions.q: She asked me ___ I had finished.
questions.explain: 「是否」用 if / whether。

questions.q: He said that he ___ tired.
questions.explain: 主句过去时，从句时态后退：was。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
options: I wonder what is he doing.
I wonder what he is doing.
I wonder what does he do.
I wonder what he does doing.
questions.explain: 从句用陈述语序。

questions.q: 介词后面表示「是否」只能用？
questions.explain: 介词后、or not 前、句首用 whether。

questions.q: 宾语从句的语序规则是？
options: 陈述语序（主语 + 谓语）
questions.explain: 从句永远是陈述语序。

units.title: 定语从句：给名词加一条说明
units.thinking: 中文习惯把修饰语放前面（「我昨天买的书」），英语则把长修饰语放到名词后面，用 who/which/that 引出一条从句。这就是「英语喜欢右展开」的思维：主干先说清，补充信息往后挂。理解这一点，就明白为什么英语句子常显得「后面越拖越长」。

rules.formula: 先行词（人）+ who/that；先行词（物）+ which/that
rules.desc: The man who called you is my uncle.

rules.formula: 关系词在从句中作宾语时可省略
rules.desc: The book (that) I bought is good.

rules.formula: 非限制性定语从句用逗号隔开，只能用 which/who，不能用 that
rules.desc: My father, who is a doctor, works here.

examples.en: The book that I bought yesterday is interesting.
examples.zh: 我昨天买的那本书很有意思。

examples.en: The book I bought it yesterday is interesting.
examples.zh: ✗ 关系词已作宾语，不能再加 it

examples.en: My mother, who is a teacher, loves reading.
examples.zh: 我妈妈是老师，她爱读书。（非限制性）

examples.en: My mother, that is a teacher, loves reading.
examples.zh: ✗ 非限制性从句不能用 that

mistakes: 从句里重复宾语：the book that I bought it ✗
该用 which 的地方用 that（非限制性从句）
关系词选错：人用 which ✗（应为 who）

questions.q: The girl ___ is singing is my sister.
questions.explain: 先行词是人且在从句作主语，用 who。

questions.q: This is the house ___ I lived in.
questions.explain: 先行词是物，用 which（也可用 that）。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
options: The film that I saw it was good.
The film that I saw was good.
The film what I saw was good.
The film who I saw was good.
questions.explain: 关系词作宾语，从句内不再重复 it。

questions.q: Mr. Li, ___ teaches English, is popular.
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句指人用 who。

questions.q: I know a boy ___ father is a pilot.
questions.explain: 表示所属关系用 whose。

questions.q: 英语习惯把长修饰语放在名词的？
questions.explain: 英语右展开：修饰语后置。

units.title: 状语从句：说明时间、原因、条件
units.thinking: 英语用从句交代「什么时候、为什么、什么条件下」，而且有一条中文没有的规则：**时间/条件状语从句里不能用 will**，要用一般现在时表将来（When he comes, I will tell him）。因为英语认为「从句先发生、主句后发生」，从句不用再标记将来。掌握这条，就抓住了状语从句最容易出错的地方。

rules.formula: 时间：when / while / before / after / as soon as / until
rules.desc: As soon as he arrives, we will start.

rules.formula: 条件：if / unless / as long as
rules.desc: If it rains, we will stay home.

rules.formula: 原因/结果：because / since / so … that / such … that
rules.desc: He was so tired that he fell asleep.

examples.en: When he comes, I will tell him.
examples.zh: 他来了我就告诉他。（从句用现在时）

examples.en: When he will come, I will tell him.
examples.zh: ✗ 时间状语从句不用 will

examples.en: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
examples.zh: 除非你快点，否则会迟到。

examples.en: Because he was ill, so he didn't come.
examples.zh: ✗ because 与 so 不能同时用

mistakes: 时间/条件状语从句里用 will
because 和 so 连用、although 和 but 连用（中文习惯，英语不行）
so…that 与 such…that 混用（so + 形容词/副词；such + 名词短语）

questions.q: I will call you as soon as I ___ home.
questions.explain: 时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来。

questions.q: ___ you study hard, you will pass.
questions.explain: 条件用 if。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
options: Although he is rich, but he is unhappy.
Although he is rich, he is unhappy.
Because he is rich, so he is happy.
He is rich, although but unhappy.
questions.explain: although 不与 but 连用。

questions.q: He was ___ tired that he fell asleep at once.
questions.explain: so + 形容词 + that。

questions.q: ___ it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
questions.explain: 条件状语从句。

questions.q: 时间状语从句表将来时，谓语用？
questions.explain: 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will。

units.title: 名词性从句：主语、表语、同位语
units.thinking: 宾语从句你已经会了，其实同一个「句子降级成名词」的机制还能放在主语位置（主语从句）、be 动词后面（表语从句）、名词后面解释内容（同位语从句）。英语对「从句在句中担任什么角色」非常敏感，这就是为什么同一个 that 引导的从句，语法功能却完全不同——判断方法永远是问：它在句里顶替了哪个名词？

rules.formula: 主语从句：What he said / That he lied + 谓语
rules.desc: What he said is true. / It is important that you come.

rules.formula: 表语从句：be + that / whether / 疑问词从句
rules.desc: The problem is that we have no time.

rules.formula: 同位语从句：抽象名词（fact / idea / news）+ that 从句解释内容
rules.desc: The fact that he lied surprised us.

examples.en: What he said is true.
examples.zh: 他说的是真的。（主语从句）

examples.en: That he said is true.
examples.zh: ✗ 缺成分，应改为 What he said

examples.en: The problem is that we have no time.
examples.zh: 问题是我们没有时间。（表语从句）

examples.en: The news that he won made us happy.
examples.zh: 他获胜的消息让我们很高兴。（同位语从句）

mistakes: 主语从句用 that 时忘记形式主语 it（It is important that…）
what 与 that 混用（what = 先行词 + 关系词，本身在从句中作成分）
同位语从句与定语从句混淆（同位语从句 that 不作成分，只起连接作用）

questions.q: ___ she said made me angry.
questions.explain: what 在从句中作宾语，等于「她说的（话）」。

questions.q: It is important ___ we protect the environment.
questions.explain: It 作形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。

questions.q: The reason is ___ he was late.
questions.explain: 表语从句用 that（reason is that…）。

questions.q: The fact ___ she passed the exam surprised us.
questions.explain: 同位语从句解释 fact 的内容。

questions.q: what 与 that 的关键区别是？
options: what 本身在从句中作成分，that 只连接不作成分
questions.explain: what 有实义、作成分；that 只是连接词。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
questions.explain: 从句缺宾语，要用 what。

units.title: 语篇连接：让句子之间有关系
units.thinking: 英语写作的评分点常常不在单句，而在「句子之间有没有逻辑关系」。中文可以靠意合（意思连上就行），英语更依赖显性连接词：转折 however、因果 therefore、递进 moreover、举例 for instance。这一单元的思维是：**让逻辑关系出现在字面上**，而不是让读者猜。

rules.formula: 转折：however / nevertheless / on the contrary
rules.desc: 放在句首并加逗号：However, the result was different.

rules.formula: 因果：therefore / thus / as a result / consequently
rules.desc: He was late. Therefore, he missed the train.

rules.formula: 递进/补充：moreover / furthermore / in addition / besides
rules.desc: Moreover, the cost is too high.

examples.en: The task is hard. However, we can finish it.
examples.zh: 任务很难，但我们可以完成。

examples.en: The task is hard. But however, we can finish it.
examples.zh: ✗ but 与 however 不能叠用

examples.en: He studied hard. As a result, he passed.
examples.zh: 他努力学习，结果通过了。

examples.en: He studied hard. As a result of, he passed.
examples.zh: ✗ as a result of 后面要接名词

mistakes: but 与 however、because 与 so 同时使用
连接副词当连词用（However he was tired. ✗ 需加逗号或用 but）
逗号连接两个完整句子（comma splice），应用分号或连接词

questions.q: He was ill. ___ , he still came to work.
questions.explain: 前后是转折关系。

questions.q: It rained heavily. ___ , the match was cancelled.
questions.explain: 因果关系用 as a result。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
options: He is rich. But however he is sad.
He is rich. However, he is sad.
He is rich, however he is sad.
He is rich however, he is sad.
questions.explain: however 单独使用并加逗号。

questions.q: 表示「此外、而且」的是？
questions.explain: moreover 表递进。

questions.q: 逗号连接两个完整句子在英语中称为？
options: comma splice（需改为分号或加连词）
questions.explain: 这是常见写作错误。

questions.q: 英语写作更看重？
options: 句间逻辑明确（显性连接）
questions.explain: 英语偏好显性逻辑连接。

units.title: 英语思维专题：信息结构与焦点
units.thinking: 把前面 22 个单元串起来看，英语有一条贯穿始终的习惯：**重要的信息放前面，新信息放后面**，并且用形式把它标出来（被动语态换焦点、there be 引出新事物、it 作形式主语后置真主语、倒装强调）。中文常靠语境和语气词，英语靠结构。学会「先定焦点、再选结构」，你的句子会立刻变得像英语。

rules.formula: 已知信息在前，新信息在后
rules.desc: A man came in. The man was carrying a box.（第二次用 the）

rules.formula: 强调新事物用 there be；强调受事用被动
rules.desc: There is a problem. / The problem was solved.

rules.formula: 长主语用 it 后置；想强调用倒装
rules.desc: It is important to sleep well. / Never have I seen this.

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有一本书。（引出新信息）

examples.en: A book is on the desk.
examples.zh: △ 语法可通，但英语更常用 there be 引出新事物

examples.en: It is hard to learn a language well.
examples.zh: 学好一门语言很难。（it 后置长主语）

examples.en: To learn a language well is hard.
examples.zh: △ 语法对，但显得头重脚轻，英语更常用 it 结构

mistakes: 把中文「有」直译成 have：The desk has a book ✗（应为 There is a book on the desk）
主语过长不后置，造成头重脚轻
焦点混乱：该用被动时硬用主动，导致主语莫名其妙

questions.q: 「桌上有一本书」最自然的英语是？
options: There is a book on the desk.
A book there is on the desk.
On the desk has a book.
questions.explain: 引出新事物用 there be。

questions.q: 「学好英语很重要」更地道的说法是？
options: It is important to learn English well.
questions.explain: it 作形式主语，真主语后置。

questions.q: 第二次提到同一事物时应用？
questions.explain: 已知信息用 the。

questions.q: 想强调「受事」时用什么结构？
questions.explain: 被动语态把受事提到主语位置。

questions.q: 英语信息结构的一般原则是？
questions.explain: 已知信息先出现，新信息靠后。

questions.q: 中文「这栋楼是 1990 年建的」用英语更自然的是？
questions.explain: 焦点在楼，用被动。
